title: Practice 11: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **бегаешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
**бродил** — past tense (masculine) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).
**плавают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).

exercises.q: Кошка ___ (бежать — to run, one way) за мышью.
exercises.why: **бежала** — past tense (feminine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: A cat ran after a mouse.

exercises.why: **катаешься** — present tense (2nd person singular) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).

exercises.q: Я видел, как он ___ (бежать — to run, one way).
exercises.why: **бежал** — past tense (masculine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Группа ___ (бежать — to run, one way) по пляжу.
exercises.why: **бежит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: The group is running on the beach.

exercises.q: Не ___ (лезть — to climb, one way) в дела Тома.
exercises.why: **лезьте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).
**катаетесь** — present tense (2nd person plural) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).

exercises.q: Он ___ (бежать — to run, one way) во всю прыть.
exercises.why: **бежал** — past tense (masculine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: He ran as fast as he could.

exercises.q: Не ___ (бежать — to run, one way), иди медленно.
exercises.why: **беги** — imperative (ты, singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
